## History

Phillips served as the master at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolhouse, securing his position through the influence of his uncle while boarding at the home of Eben Wright. During class, he punished [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) for smashing her slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head by forcing her to stand at the blackboard with a message criticizing her temper.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as a mentor to [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolhouse. While presiding over the local schoolroom, he maintains a professional role as her instructor during her studies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027)_
